headline: ‘Everyone Is Doing It’: The Truth About AI in Hollywood
context: Puck’s Matthew Belloni says AI has quietly become part of everyday filmmaking. The battle now isn’t whether Hollywood will use the technology—it’s who controls what’ll come next.
